extension.summary: A procedural plant growing from a seed, for 32-bit Android Kodi (many Fire TV and Google TV devices)
extension.description: The same Growing Plant as "Growing Plant (OpenGL)", built for 32-bit Android (armeabi-v7a). Install this one if your Android or Google TV Kodi is a 32-bit app, which is the case on many Fire TV sticks, Google TV boxes and the Chromecast with Google TV; install "Growing Plant (OpenGL)" on 64-bit Android, macOS and Intel/Apple Macs. One plant at a time grows from nothing: a trunk extends, branches unfold, leaves open and the whole thing sways in the wind, then it holds while the camera circles, sways, spirals or climbs around it. Each plant is generated from an L-system / node graph, so every cycle is a different tree, bush, fern or fan-leaf plant, with an occasional L-system pattern drawn in glowing tubes. Six hand-tuned skies range from dawn to night to an aurora, plus a flat no-background option that skips the sky pass entirely; pick one or let the screensaver rotate through them. The growth is done on the GPU: the plant is a single mesh whose vertices know when they are born, so it animates without rebuilding anything. Choose the plant, seed, leaf density, growth speed, camera movement, framing, background and detail; all are optional. This 32-bit build defaults to Low detail, which drops leaves, branches, particles and the sky's cloud noise to keep a low-power box smooth; switch to Normal or High if the device can afford it.
extension.disclaimer: This is a native add-on: it is built per platform and Kodi version (this one: Kodi 21 Omega, 32-bit ARM Android). The plant generator is the TwoOL procedural plant / L-system core from this repository, vendored into src/twol under the MIT licence in LICENSE.txt.
